item_name: Rothco Deluxe Thin Blue Line Flag
item_short_desc: Rothco's Deluxe Thin Blue Line Flag is crafted from durable polyester, allowing you to display it proudly throughout the year. Featuring the Thin Blue Line design, this American flag symbolizes respect and support for law enforcement officials. The flag features raised embroidered stars and double stitching on the stripes, ensuring that it withstands wear and tear while being outside. The Grommet holes allow for easy hanging and display in various settings.
